zh.title: Stratolaunch 購入 Boeing 777-200ER　改裝支援 Talon-A 空中發射
zh.summary: Stratolaunch 新增第三架發射母機，預計 2027 年完成 777-200ER 改裝。
body: Stratolaunch 於 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布，已購入一架 Boeing 777-200ER，將用於支援可重複使用、自主飛行的 Talon-A 高超音速測試載具。
這架 777 將與現有 Roc 及 Spirit of Mojave 組成三架母機機隊。公司估計新增航機可使整體飛行容量提升 35%，並增加全球部署與平行執行任務的彈性；這是公司預期，尚非營運實績。
航機仍須改裝，以便從機身發射 Talon-A，預計於 2027 年完成。此次購入不表示 777 已具備發射能力或開始執行高超音速測試。

en.title: Stratolaunch acquires Boeing 777-200ER for Talon-A air-launch missions
en.summary: The company expects to complete modifications to its third carrier aircraft in 2027.
body: Stratolaunch announced on September 30, 2026 that it had acquired a Boeing 777-200ER to support its reusable, autonomous Talon-A hypersonic test vehicles.

The aircraft will complement Roc and Spirit of Mojave. Stratolaunch forecasts a 35% increase in overall flight capacity, with greater global deployment flexibility and support for parallel missions. That figure is a company projection.
Modifications for fuselage air-launch operations are expected to finish in 2027. Acquisition does not mean the 777 is already equipped to launch Talon-A or conducting hypersonic test missions.

facts.claim: Third carrier alongside Roc and Spirit of Mojave; projected 35% capacity increase.
Modifications to launch Talon-A from fuselage expected complete in 2027.
